c1.hasil_ringkas: Pada 16 pohon mangga, hitungan multi-pandang terhadap hitungan panen memberi kemiringan 1,014 (galat 1,36%) dengan R2 = 0,90 tanpa kalibrasi; pandangan tunggal hanya menghitung 27% buah (R2 = 0,81) dan pandangan ganda 54% (R2 = 0,94). F1 deteksi Faster R-CNN 0,881.

bukti: pair-wise correspondences are established between images using trajectory data provided by a navigation system
must be associated and tracked throughout the sequence of all images in which they are seen, to avoid counting the same fruit multiple times
The fruit was tallied by counting the number of unique ids per tree, per row and in total for the whole orchard block.
catatan: Asosiasi antarbingkai berurutan memakai garis epipolar dari pose GPS/INS dan penugasan Hungarian; tidak ada fitur penampilan. Dikodekan M3+M4 karena pelacakan berantai antarbingkai dengan biaya geometris murni; apabila konvensi hanya menghitung isyarat asosiasi, kode yang tepat adalah M4. C5 ikut cocok karena buah ditriangulasi dalam 3D dan LiDAR dipakai untuk mengaitkan buah ke pohon.

bukti: a FFB is inserted into a light tight box which contains a laser diode and a CMOS camera, the FFB is illuminated, and then an image is recorded
The FFBs were then brought to Lab and cleaned.
Based on the tables, the most category is found on the front surface of base section of FFB by 75%
catatan: Pencitraan bio-speckle laser 650 nm pada TBS yang sudah dipanen di laboratorium. Setiap tandan direkam enam kali (permukaan depan dan belakang, tiga bagian), tetapi setiap citra diklasifikasikan sendiri tanpa penggabungan, sehingga bukan C1. Tugas dapat pula dibaca sebagai KLS; SENSOR dipilih karena kontribusinya adalah modalitas laser. Hasil utama: Tabel 2 dan 3, h. 6-7.

bukti: evaluate and compare the performance of four generations of YOLO models (YOLOv5, YOLOv8, YOLOv9, and YOLOv11) for detecting loose fruits palm oil
A total of 20 different model scales were tested using a carefully annotated plantation image dataset resized to $640 \times$ 640 pixels.

bukti: Implementation of multispectral imaging for the task needs wavelength selection from hyperspectral datasets.
This study aimed to obtain the optimum wavelengths and use them for oil palm FFB classification based on three ripeness levels.
